🍁🚂 JIM THORPE, PA — Pennsylvania’s Little Switzerland! 🇨🇭✨ A charming Victorian mountain town in the Poconos, filled with colorful fall foliage, scenic train rides, delicious donuts & historic streets! 🍂🏔️ 🍩 DONERDS DONUTS — @donerdsdonuts 📍 Broadway St Started our day with delicious fresh donuts! A must-visit sweet stop! 😍 🚂 LEHIGH GORGE SCENIC RAILWAY @visitjimthorpe 📍 1 Susquehanna St Enjoy a breathtaking train ride through the mountains alongside the Lehigh River! 🍁 🎟️ Adults ~$24 | Kids ~$10 ✨ Vista Dome seating available 🌐 www.lgsry.com 🚌 JIM THORPE TROLLEY — @jimthorpetrolley Explore Victorian architecture, local history & hidden gems on a 70-minute guided tour! 🎟️ Adults ~$25–30 🌐 www.jimthorpetrolley.com 🅿️ PARKING GUIDE — SAVE THIS! 🚗 Main Parking Lot — 2 Susquehanna St 💰 Approx. $12/6 hrs or $20/day 🚗 Downtown Parking — Broadway St & nearby areas 💰 Metered and paid parking; limited availability 🚗 Fall Festival Shuttle 🍁 Off-site parking & shuttle services may be available during October festival weekends. 🚗 Private Lots — Around downtown 💰 Rates vary; often higher on busy weekends 📲 Parking & festival updates: www.jimthorpe.org 🏞️ MORE TO EXPLORE 🥾 Lehigh Gorge State Park ☕ Muggle’s Mug 🏘️ Historic Broadway Street 🚴 Scenic biking & hiking trails 📸 Victorian architecture & mountain views 💡 TRAVEL TIPS 🍁 Arrive early on fall weekends! 🚂 Book train & trolley tickets ahead. 👟 Wear comfy shoes — the town is hilly! 📸 October is beautiful for fall colors. 💰 Confirm current prices & schedules. 🚗 ~2 hrs from NYC | ~1.5 hrs from Philly 🍂 A perfect Pennsylvania fall getaway! ❤️ 📌 SAVE for your next trip! 💬 Tag your travel buddy! ✨ Follow @journeytechie for more travel guides! #JimThorpePA #PoconoMountains #DonerdsDonuts #JimThorpeTrolley #LehighGorgeScenicRailway FallFoliage PennsylvaniaTravel Poconos JimThorpePA PoconoMountains OutdoorAdventures TravelPA Hiking Rafting LocalVibes TourismPA 🌟 FallGeta, way WeekendTrips @journeytechie

#greatfallsnationalpark ❄️ Great Falls, Maryland January to December Travel Guide 🤍🍁 Planning a winter getaway to Great Falls? Save this guide! 📌 📍 Location: Great Falls, Maryland Side — Chesapeake & Ohio Canal National Historical Park, Potomac, MD 🧥 Clothing: Warm winter jacket, thermals, gloves, scarf, and comfortable hiking boots. It can get very windy near the waterfalls! 🚗 Parking: Available at the Great Falls Tavern Visitor Center parking area. 🎟️ Entrance Fee: Typically $20 per private vehicle. 🏛️ Visitor Center: Great Falls Tavern Visitor Center — check seasonal opening hours before visiting. ⏰ Best Visiting Time: 10 AM–2 PM for scenic views and beautiful pictures. 🥾 Must Visit: Great Falls Overlook via the Olmsted Island Bridges and the scenic C&O Canal Towpath. 📸 Photo Tip: Winter mornings are perfect for capturing the waterfalls without summer crowds! 🌅 Sunset: Around 4:45–5:00 PM in December. ✨ Save this post for your next Maryland winter adventure! #greatfallsnationalpark #greatfallsmd #marylandtravel #dmvtravel GreatFallsPark, PotomacMaryland, CAndOCanal MarylandHiddenGems, TravelReels, WeekendGetaway

Hersey chocolate world, Harrisburg, PA Walk into Hershey’s Chocolate World in Harrisburg, PA and it literally feels like stepping into a candy wonderland 🍫✨ The iconic purple marquee lights glow “HERSHEY’S” above a bold red banner with “CHOCOLATE WORLD” and the classic Hershey’s Kiss in the center — it’s the photo spot right at the entrance. The colorful cartoon mural with orange hills, blue clouds, and castle turrets makes it 10x more fun for families and chocolate lovers alike. And the best part? It’s 100% free to enter. You can snap as many pics as you want, shop limited-edition chocolates you won’t find anywhere else, and soak up that sweet, playful vibe. If you’re road-tripping through Pennsylvania, this is an easy, family-friendly stop you’ll actually want to remember. #HersheysChocolateWorld #HersheyPA #HarrisburgPA #ChocolateLovers #FamilyTravel PennsylvaniaRoadTrip SweetTooth CandyLovers TravelWithKids PhotoSpot FreeAttraction ChocolateWorldVibes Hershey’s Chocolate World entrance, family-friendly Pennsylvania attraction, free chocolate experience, colorful marquee sign, Hershey’s Kiss landmark, limited edition chocolates, kid-friendly travel stop, Pennsylvania tourism, photo-worthy destination, candy-themed attraction, road trip stop PA
